_comment: One judge profile per judge model; every size limit tied to the judge is derived from the selected one (judge_profile.py for Python, src/judge-profile.ts for Node, which apply the same rules). Pick one with SUPERJEV_JUDGE_PROFILE (default below). window_tokens is the judge's hard input ceiling for the state plus the longest question; max_questions_per_call is how many questions one call may carry; question_kinds are the answer shapes the judge supports; input_usd_per_mtok and output_usd_per_mtok are its published prices per million tokens.
